summary: Iteration 33 – Full backend+frontend validation of GET /api/finance/overdue-evolution and the new OverdueEvolutionChart on /finance. 18/18 pytest cases PASS (shape, math consistency, days clamp 1/0/400, auth 401 & 403, and regressions on /dashboard, /collections/today, /clients, /promises, /data-health). Frontend renders the chart with correct KPI values (221 € recovered, 221 € newly overdue, 0 € delta) and the exact 'Estagnado — recuperado a compensar novas vencidas' badge that spec requires for delta=0. Recharts SVG paints, tooltip is functional, tabs (Cobranças Hoje / Clientes / Promessas) remain navigable, freshness badge preserved.

issues: Right Y-axis (scale for the two Bar series) shows '0k' repeated on every tick because both bar values (221 €) are tiny compared to the '(v/1000).toFixed(0)k' formatter — labels collapse to 0k. Consider using a smarter formatter (e.g. show '221' if v<1000 else `${(v/1000).toFixed(0)}k`) or removing the right-axis ticks when max bar value < 1000. Cosmetic only — chart still renders correctly.

action_items: (Optional, cosmetic) Improve the right-axis tick formatter in OverdueEvolutionChart.js so that sub-1k values don't all display as '0k'. Suggested: `tickFormatter={(v) => v >= 1000 ? `${(v/1000).toFixed(0)}k` : `${v}`}`.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/modules/finance/routes.py: the endpoint uses a hard limit `days=max(1, min(days, 365))` but does not declare `days` as a Query with ge/le validation. Consider `days: int = Query(30, ge=1, le=365)` so FastAPI returns 422 for invalid input instead of silently clamping (current behaviour is fine but hides caller bugs).

The math for `newly_overdue = net_change + recovered` assumes recovered_amount is expressed on the same signed convention as overdue drops. This holds today because recovery events are always positive amounts subtracted from overdue. If a future 'reverse recovery' (e.g. reopened invoice) is inserted with negative amount, the formula still works, but a comment/unit-test lock would help.
OverdueEvolutionChart.js imports `Badge` from '../../components/ui/badge' but never uses the component (only uses the custom pill div). Remove the unused import to satisfy eslint no-unused-vars.
OverdueEvolutionChart.js: error state only shows generic 'Erro ao carregar histórico' — swallows the axios error. Consider surfacing e.response?.data?.detail for easier support debugging.

The chart re-fetches on every `days` change but has no abort controller — if user rapidly toggles the period selector (once one exists), stale responses can arrive out of order and overwrite fresher data. Wrap with AbortController + cleanup in useEffect.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (chart renders, KPIs correct, trend badge correct, regressions OK)
